cpsc-26309.title: Unique Brands Com Recalls Forever 21 Pajama Pants Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Burn Hazard; Violates Mandatory Flammability Standards for Children's Sleepwear
cpsc-26309.product: Forever 21 Kids Disney Mickey Mouse Pajama Pants
cpsc-26309.reason: The recalled children's pajama pants violate the mandatory standards for flammability of children's sleepwear, posing a burn hazard and risk of serious injury or death to children.
cpsc-26309.company: Unique Brands Com, Inc., of New York, New York
cpsc-26309.distribution: Sold in the United States at Online at Forever21.com from September 2025 through November 2025 for about $25.
cpsc-26309.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled pajama pants immediately and contact Unique Brands Com for a full refund. Consumers will be provided with a prepaid shipping label to return the recalled kids pajama pants. Refund
retailers: Online at Forever21.com from September 2025 through November 2025 for about $25.

images.caption: Recalled Forever 21 Kids Disney Mickey Mouse Pajama Pants

cpsc-26309.description: This recall involves Forever 21 Kids Disney Mickey Mouse Pajama Pants with black stripes. The pajama pants were sold in children's sizes 5/6, 7/8, 9/10, 11/12 and 13/14. The size and "Forever 21" are printed on the red and black label at the waist of the pants. The pajamas pants have the item number 01334347 located on a sewn-in, side-seam label below the bar code.
cpsc-26309.consumer_contact: Unique Brands Com toll-free at 888-684-5375 from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. ET Tuesday through Thursday, email at recall@forever21.com, or online at Forever21.com/pages/product-recalls or Forever21.com and click "Recall" at the top of the page for more information.

cpsc-26312.title: Tomum Minoxidil Hair Serum Spray Bottles Recalled Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Child Poisoning; Violates Mandatory Standard for Child-Resistant Packaging; Distributed by Belleka
cpsc-26312.product: Tomum Hair Regrowth Treatment with Minoxidil for Men and Women Spray Bottles
cpsc-26312.reason: The hair serum contains minoxidil, which must be in child-resistant packaging as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act. The hair serum's bottles are not child-resistant, posing a risk of serious injury or death from poisoning if the contents are swallowed by young children.
cpsc-26312.company: Belleka Inc, dba TOMUM, of China, Chifengrongxiangshangmaoyouxiangongsi, dba Haircare Solution, of China, SOLUVIA LLC, of Brooklyn, New York, US, Xingchang Technology Co., Ltd., dba Xingchang, of China
cpsc-26312.distribution: Sold in the United States at Online at Amazon.com from March 2025 through September 2025 for about $20.
cpsc-26312.remedy: Consumers should secure the recalled serum bottles out of sight and reach of children immediately and contact Belleka for a free replacement product, including two child-resistant bottles of serum (60 mL per unit). Consumers will be asked to dispose of the recalled product bottle and send a photo of the bottle in the trash to Belleka at tomumcs@gmail.com. Replace
retailers: Online at Amazon.com from March 2025 through September 2025 for about $20.

images.caption: Recalled Tomum Minoxidil Hair Regrowth Treatment (Front view)
Recalled Tomum Minoxidil -Hair Regrowth Treatment (Rear view)

cpsc-26312.description: This recall involves spray bottles for Tomum Minoxidil Hair Growth Treatment, 100 mL. The spray bottles are silver with a blue wraparound label and black cap. The bottles are packaged in a blue box and both the bottle and box have "TOMUM" and "Hair Growth Treatment" printed on labels located on their fronts.
cpsc-26312.consumer_contact: Belleka at 862 244-1785 from 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. ET Monday through Friday, email at tomumcs@gmail.com, or online at https://itomum.com/contact-us/ or https://itomum.com for more information.

cpsc-26315.title: HALO Dream Recalls Magic Sleepsuits Due to Choking Hazard
cpsc-26315.reason: The zipper head can detach from certain sleepsuits, posing a choking hazard to infants.
cpsc-26315.company: HALO Dream, Inc., of New York City
cpsc-26315.distribution: Sold in the United States at Halosleep.com, Amazon.com, Walmart.com and Target.com from September 2025 through February 2026 for about $50.
cpsc-26315.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled HALO Magic Sleepsuit immediately and go to the firm's website at http://www.sleepsuitrecall.com to participate in the recall. After registering, consumers will receive a coupon code that can be applied towards a replacement sleepsuit or a $50 store credit to purchase another item on the firm's website. Do not discard the recalled garment until you have received the coupon code. Refund Replace
retailers: Halosleep.com, Amazon.com, Walmart.com and Target.com from September 2025 through February 2026 for about $50.

images.caption: Recalled HALO Magic Sleepsuit
The sewn in label with the batch code and "Made in India" circled
The hang tag with the batch code and "Made in India" circled

cpsc-26315.injuries: The firm has received 15 reports of the zipper head detaching from the garment. No injuries have been reported.
cpsc-26315.description: This recall involves HALO Magic Sleepsuit with batch codes PO30592, PO30641 and PO30685. The recalled infant sleepsuit shell and lining are made from 100% cotton and the fill is made from 100% polyester. It has double zippers running down each side of the front of the garment. It was sold in a variety of colors in small and large sizes. "HALO Magic Sleepsuit" is printed on the front of the sleepsuit. The batch codes and "Made in India" are printed on the sewn-in label inside the garment and the hang tag affixed to the outside of the sleepsuit.
cpsc-26315.consumer_contact: HALO Dream toll-free at 833-791-0420 from 9 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. ET Monday through Friday, by e-mail at customerservice@sleepsuitrecall.com, or online at www.sleepsuitrecall.com, or go to www.halosleep.com and click on "Recalls" at the bottom of the page for more information.

cpsc-26317.title: Cubimana Island Storm 3 In 1 Building Sets Recalled Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Battery Ingestion; Violates Mandatory Standard for Toys; Sold on Amazon by RBS Toys
cpsc-26317.product: Cubimana Island Storm 3 In 1 Building Sets with LED Lights
cpsc-26317.reason: The Island Storm Building Sets violate the mandatory safety standard for toys because the battery compartment within the LED light piece contains button cell batteries that can be easily accessed by children. When button cell or coin batteries are swallowed, the ingested batteries can cause serious injuries, internal chemical burns and death.
cpsc-26317.company: Shenzhen Ruibosi Technology Co., Ltd., dba RBS Toys, of China
cpsc-26317.distribution: Sold in the United States at Online at Amazon.com from October 2025 through January 2026 for about $30.
cpsc-26317.remedy: Consumers should take the Island Storm 3 In 1 Building Sets away from children immediately, stop using the recalled toys and remove and properly dispose of the batteries. Consumers will be asked to throw the product away and send a photo of the disposed product to productrecall@cubimanatoys.com to receive a full refund. Note: Button cell and coin batteries are hazardous. Batteries should be disposed of or recycled by following local hazardous waste procedures. Refund
retailers: Online at Amazon.com from October 2025 through January 2026 for about $30.

cpsc-26317.consumer_contact: RBS Toys by email at productrecall@cubimanatoys.com.

cpsc-26319.title: Stoney Games Recalls Kluster Magnet Chess Games Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Magnet Ingestion; Violates Mandatory Standard for Toys
cpsc-26319.product: Kluster Fun Tabletop Magnet Chess Games
cpsc-26319.reason: The recalled magnet games violate the mandatory standard for toys because they contain loose high-powered magnets that fit within CPSC's small parts cylinder, posing an ingestion hazard to children. When high-powered magnets are swallowed, the ingested magnets can attract each other, or other metal objects, and become lodged in the digestive system. This can result in perforations, twisting, and/or blockage of the intestines, blood poisoning and death.
cpsc-26319.company: Stoney Games, LLC of Bexley, Ohio
cpsc-26319.distribution: Sold in the United States at Independent game shops nationwide, and online at Klustermagnets.com, Amazon.com, and Etsy.com from October 2018 to September 2025 for between $15 and $2.
cpsc-26319.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled magnet games, take them away from children and contact Stoney Games for instructions on how to dispose of the recalled magnets and receive replacement magnets that are not small parts. Replace
retailers: Independent game shops nationwide, and online at Klustermagnets.com, Amazon.com, and Etsy.com from October 2018 to September 2025 for between $15 and $2.

images.caption: Recalled Kluster Fun Tabletop Magnet Chess Game (Sold in White Pouch)
Recalled Kluster Fun Tabletop Magnet Chess Game (Back of Pouch with Gameplay Instructions)
Recalled Kluster Fun Tabletop Magnet Chess Game (Game Contents Sold in Black Box)

cpsc-26319.description: This recall involves the Kluster Fun Tabletop Magnet Chess Games with small, loose magnets about .5 to one inch wide and .3 to .4 inches high. The games are sold in a black box with the word "Kluster" on the front of the box. The games include about 24 magnets, an orange string, an instruction manual and a black storage pouch with "Kluster" printed on the front. The games were also sold in a white pouch with gameplay instructions printed on the back.
cpsc-26319.consumer_contact: Stoney Games at 800-362-0977 from 8 a.m. to p.m. ET, Monday through Friday, email at klusterrecall@gmail.com or online at www.klustermagnets.com/recall or www.klustermagnets.com and click "Recall" at the top of the page for more information.

cpsc-26320.title: ProRider Recalls Bicycle Helmets Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Head Injury; Violates Mandatory Standard for Bicycle Helmets
cpsc-26320.reason: The recalled helmets violate the mandatory safety standard for bicycle helmets because the helmets do not comply with the impact attenuation, positional stability, labeling and certification requirements. The helmets can fail to protect the user in the event of a crash, posing a serious risk of injury or death due to head injury.

retailers: Distributed by Wisconsin Bike Federation, Kiwanis Club, Foster Love nationwide, and sold online at ProRider.com from June 2022 through May 2023 for between $5 and $18.

cpsc-26321.title: LIVEHOM 11-Drawer Dressers Recalled Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Tip-Over and Entrapment Hazards; Violates Mandatory Standard for Clothing Storage Units; Sold on Amazon by Simplehome
cpsc-26321.reason: The recalled dressers are unstable if they are not anchored to the wall, posing tip-over and entrapment hazards that can result in risks of serious injuries or death to children. The dressers violate the mandatory safety standard as required by the STURDY Act.
cpsc-26321.company: Shenzhen Lvmukeji Co., Ltd., dba Simplehome, of China
cpsc-26321.distribution: Sold in the United States at Online at Amazon.com from December 2025 through January 2026 for about $110.
cpsc-26321.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled dressers if they are not anchored to the wall and place them in an area that children cannot access. Contact Simplehome for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to write "RECALL" with permanent marker on the dressers and send a photo of the marked dressers to livehomerecall@163.com. Consumers should then dispose of the recalled product. Refund
retailers: Online at Amazon.com from December 2025 through January 2026 for about $110.

cpsc-26324.title: LFTE USA Recalls Playground Swing Set Seats Due to Fall Hazard

cpsc-26328.title: Wagner Spray Tech Recalls 900 Series Power Steamers Due to Burn Hazard
cpsc-26328.reason: The attached hose can get excessively hot and the nozzle/gun can expel hot water during use and after the trigger is engaged, posing a serious burn hazard to consumers.
cpsc-26328.company: Wagner Spray Tech Corp. of Plymouth, Minnesota
cpsc-26328.distribution: Sold in the United States at The Home Depot, Lowe's, Walmart, Target, HSN and QVC, and online at Amazon.com and www.wagnerspraytech.com from November 2018 to March 2026 for between $130 and $200.
cpsc-26328.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled steamers immediately and contact Wagner for a free repair kit, consisting of a hose sleeve, nozzle cover and funnel. Repair
retailers: The Home Depot, Lowe's, Walmart, Target, HSN and QVC, and online at Amazon.com and www.wagnerspraytech.com from November 2018 to March 2026 for between $130 and $200.

images.caption: Recalled Wagner Model 905e Auto Steamer, pictured with included accessories
Recalled Wagner Model 915e Power Steamer, pictured with included accessories
Recalled Wagner Model 925e Elite Steamer, pictured with included accessories

cpsc-26328.injuries: Wagner has received at least 156 incidents involving the hose getting too hot or the nozzle/gun expelling hot water. This includes over 50 reported burn injuries to consumers' arms, hands, feet, and face, many of which resulted in first- or second-degree burns.
cpsc-26328.description: This recall involves Wagner 900 Series power steamers. Models 905e Auto Steamer, 915e On-Demand Power Steamer, and 925e Steam Machine Elite Steamer are included in this recall. All steamer models contain the same base steamer but include different accessories. The steamers include a yellow and black pressurized boiler base with "Wagner" written on the sides of the product. The model number may also appear on the sides of the product. The base also contains a clear storage compartment for accessories, a handle, wheels, an eight-foot-long black steam hose, and a nozzle/gun with trigger to start and stop the steam.
cpsc-26328.consumer_contact: Wagner toll-free at 800 962-6118 from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. ET Monday through Friday, email at us-wagnerrecall@wagner-group.com or online at www.wagnerspraytech.com/900-series-recall or go to www.wagnerspraytech.com and click on "Product Recalls" at the top of the page for more information.

This is a hidden defect because consumers who purchase and install this product may be under a false sense of security that their furniture is safe from a tip-over incident.
cpsc-26340.company: Shenzhen City Donglin E-Commerce Co., Ltd d/b/a 4our Kiddies, of China

Replace
retailers: Online at Amazon.com from June 2019 through January 2026 for between $6 and $21.

images.caption: Recalled 4our Kiddies Plastic Tip Restraint

cpsc-26340.injuries: CPSC is aware of at least 150 incidents where consumers reported that the defective plastic tip restraint kits broke, including three reported tip-over incidents.
cpsc-26340.description: This recall involves defective plastic tip restraint kits (also referred to as furniture straps) manufactured by 4our Kiddies. The recalled tip restraint kits contain two white plastic brackets/mounts (one for connection to furniture and the other for connection to the wall), a white plastic cable zip tie, two different pairs of screws (one longer than the other) and two drywall anchors. The plastic in the brackets/mounts and the cable zip tie can break or degrade over time, which could lead to furniture tipping over if a consumer interacts with furniture that was secured by the recalled product. CPSC testing revealed that the recalled plastic tip restraints failed to meet the requirements of the industry standard for tip restraints. CPSC's Anchor It! website, www.anchorit.gov/, has educational materials available to the public, including important instructions for properly anchoring furniture to prevent tip-overs.

Additionally, the screw used on the remote controls to secure the battery compartments that contain a lithium coin battery does not remain attached. Also, the packaging does not have the warnings as required by Reese's Law. When button cell or coin batteries are swallowed, the ingested batteries can cause serious injuries, internal chemical burns and death.

Note: Button cell and coin batteries are hazardous. Batteries should be disposed of or recycled by following local hazardous waste procedures. Refund
retailers: Online at Amazon.com from March 2024 through March 2026 for about $20.

cpsc-26348.injuries: Shenzhen Luobei Trading Co. has received 11 reports of the ride-on trucks catching fire, sparking, burning, melting, overheating and smoking. No injuries have been reported.
cpsc-26348.description: This recall involves FUNTOK 24V 2-Seater Ride-On Trucks, model number DLS-K03. The trucks were sold in red, black, white and pink. "4x4" is written in black on the tailgate and "TURBO DIESEL" is written in black on the side of the truck. The brand name "FUNTOK" and model number "DLS-K03" are printed on the User Manual cover and the exterior retail packaging.
cpsc-26348.consumer_contact: Shenzhen Luobei Trading Co. toll-free at 800-249-9581 from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. ET Monday through Friday, email at service@funtok.net or online at https://funtok.net/pages/voluntary-product-safety-recall or https://funtok.net/ and click on "Product Safety Recall" at the bottom of the page for more information.

cpsc-26349.title: DIY Cold Plunge Recalls Sauna Heater Kits Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fire Hazard
cpsc-26349.reason: Electrical conductors within the sauna heater kits can overheat, posing a fire hazard and risk of serious injury or death.
cpsc-26349.company: Plunge Buddy LLC, doing business as DIY Cold Plunge, of North Mankato, Minnesota
cpsc-26349.distribution: Sold in the United States at Online at www.diycoldplunge.com from March 2025 through February 2026 for between $400 and $500.
cpsc-26349.quantity: About 675 (In addition, about 14 were sold in Canada)
cpsc-26349.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled Sauna Heater Kit immediately and register at www.diycoldplunge.com/pages/recall for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to submit written and photo proof that the product has been destroyed/disposed of or request a prepaid shipping label to return the product. Refund
retailers: Online at www.diycoldplunge.com from March 2025 through February 2026 for between $400 and $500.

images.caption: Recalled DIY Sauna Heater Kit (shown assembled in sauna)
Recalled DIY Sauna Heater Kit (product photo from diycoldplunge.com)

cpsc-26349.injuries: The firm has received 12 reports of units overheating. No fires or injuries have been reported.
cpsc-26349.description: This recall involves the DIY Sauna Heater Kit. The product is a do-it-yourself kit for consumers to assemble a heating fixture with four heat-lamp bulbs (sold separately) and a metal enclosure intended for use in a separate do-it-yourself sauna enclosure, for which carpentry plans are sold separately. The Sauna Heater Kit includes a stainless steel cage (which weighs about 16 lbs., and measures 12"H x 12"W x 8"D when assembled), screws/bolts for assembly, four ceramic bulb sockets, three wire connectors, two ground pigtails, and a three-prong power cord. The recalled Sauna Heater Kit is intended to attach to a customer-built wood frame.
cpsc-26349.consumer_contact: DIY Cold Plunge by email at orders@diycoldplunge.com or online at www.diycoldplunge.com/pages/recall or www.diycoldplunge.com and click on "Recall Information" at the bottom of the page for more information.

cpsc-26350.title: MPINOI Adult Portable Bed Rails Recalled Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Entrapment and Asphyxiation; Violate Mandatory Standard for Adult Portable Bed Rails; Sold on Amazon by Bioenrrty
cpsc-26350.reason: The recalled bed rails violate the mandatory standard for adult portable bed rails because users can become entrapped within the bed rail, or between the bed rail and the side of the mattress, posing a serious entrapment hazard and risk of death by asphyxiation. In addition, the bed rails do not bear the required hazard warning labels.
cpsc-26350.company: Guangzhou Aoran Trading Co., Ltd., dba Bioenrrty, of China
cpsc-26350.distribution: Sold in the United States at Online at Amazon.com from December 2025 through February 2026 for about $30.
cpsc-26350.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled adult portable bed rails immediately and contact Bioenrrty for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to destroy the bed rails by cutting the black safety strap in half and writing "RECALLED" on the upper and lower rails with permanent marker, take a photo of the destroyed rails and email the photo to MPINOIproductrecall@outlook.com. Refund
retailers: Online at Amazon.com from December 2025 through February 2026 for about $30.

cpsc-26350.description: This recall involves MPINOI-branded adult portable bed rails. The white metal bed rails measure about 15 inches wide by 26 inches tall and have an extendable handle with gray padding and a black storage mesh pocket. "MPINOI" is printed on the mesh pocket.
